question: Why was Hitler's own cipher machine so much harder to break than Enigma?
answer: Enigma had about 10²³ possible keys. Hitler's machine had 10¹⁷⁰, more than the number of atoms in the observable universe squared. Trying every key on it was mathematically impossible.
move: Every extra digit makes brute force ten times harder.
